name: instrument
value: Fasting glucose (LBXGLU): the Roche Cobas C501 in 2013–2014, and the Roche Cobas C311 for most of 2015–2016 and in 2017–2018; GLU_I calls the years before 2015 measured on the C501, and no page names the analyzer of 2011–2012 (GLU_G names its laboratory) or of 2019–March 2020. GLU_H's page says the equipment changed in 2013–2014, with the method and the laboratory, and names no analyzer; P_GLU's list of equipment changes leaves 2013–2014 out. Blood pressure: in 2017–March 2020 three readings on an Omron HEM–907XL, an oscillometric device (P_BPXO), auscultatory measurement having ended after 2017–2018; the pages of 2011–2016 (BPX_G, BPX_H, BPX_I) name no device.
quote:

name: preprocessing
value: Fasting glucose as released: NCHS put the 2015–2016 values measured on the Cobas C501 on the C311's scale by its forward regression equation, and offers that equation, or its backward one, for combining 2015 and later values with the earlier years measured on the C501; 2015–2016 and 2017–March 2020 need no adjustment between them. A result below the detection limit holds a fill value, and a participant who gave blood without fasting 8 to under 24 hours keeps the glucose with a fasting weight of 0.
quote:
Results in this 2015-2016 dataset from specimens analyzed using the Cobas C501 were adjusted using the above forward regression equation.
Forward: Y (C311) = 1.023 (95%CI: 1.014 – 1.032) * X (C501) - 0.5108 (95%CI: -1.441 – 0.4197)
The forward equation may be used if the interest is ensuring comparability with data collected using the Cobas C311 machine (2015 and later) when comparing or combining the 2015-2016 values with other years of data.
The backwards equation can be used to ensure comparability between the 2015-2016 cycle and previous years that were measured using the Cobas C501 machine values (pre-2015).
If 2017-March 2020 pre-pandemic data are compared or combined with the 2015-2016 data, no adjustments are needed for equipment changes.
For analytes with analytic results below the lower limit of detection (ex., LBDGLULC=1), an imputed fill value was placed in the analyte results field.
participants whom provided blood specimen but did not meet the 8 to less than 24 hour fasting criteria (n=268) have the sample weight value assigned as “0” (WTSAFPRP=0) as well.
Glucose measurements for these 268 participants are included in the dataset.
